description.narrative: Mexican Hydrogen Association (MHA) will identify regions where there are ongoing hydrogen projects, and regions, which may be suitable for hydrogen project development, with a focus on green hydrogen. - Evaluate legal and industrial policy framework (e.g., incentives, availability of infrastructure, etc.), including possible barriers that might impact investor risk and competitiveness of Mexican green hydrogen projects vis a vis similar projects in neighboring regions (Latin America, USA, Canada) - Perform economic, social and environmental analysis of potential impact of green hydrogen projects on the Mexican society - Analyse and reflect on the existence of different possible green hydrogen certification schemes for different markets (green, blue, turquoise etc.) and the impact on competitiveness of different forms of hydrogen projects in a Mexican context - Carry out interviews with key stakeholders in Mexico at federal and state level as well as the private sector to evaluate opportunities and challenges in the future hydrogen market in Mexico. - Present policy recommendations at federal and state level. All of the above will be put together considering different aspects of the hydrogen value chain and the involvement of stakeholders to finally conclude with a green hydrogen roadmap for Mexico with a special focus on the participation of Danish companies in this type of project.
